details: Bitcoin has maintained a "fragile equilibrium" near $75,000, with robust demand from Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) acting as a cushion for the broader crypto market despite ongoing geopolitical uncertainties in the Strait of Hormuz.
title: Bitcoin Holds Steady Amid Geopolitical Tensions, ETF Demand Strong

details: Global crypto investment funds recorded $1.4 billion in weekly inflows, marking the second-strongest week since January. This surge is largely attributed to Bitcoin's recent rebound and an increased risk appetite among investors.
title: Crypto Funds Attract $1.4 Billion in Weekly Inflows

details: Strategy, a prominent institutional holder, spent $2.54 billion to purchase 34,000 Bitcoin (BTC). Concurrently, Bitmine made its largest weekly acquisition of the year, adding 101,627 Ethereum (ETH) to its reserves, bringing its total holdings to over 4% of the ETH supply.
title: Strategy Acquires 34,000 BTC, Bitmine Increases ETH Holdings

details: The recent $290 million Kelp exploit has brought to light critical security vulnerabilities within cross-chain decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols. This incident underscores the inherent risks in these ecosystems, prompting concerns among investors.
title: Kelp DAO Exploit Exposes Critical Cross-Chain DeFi Security Risks

details: The RAVE token experienced a dramatic 95% crash, leading to fresh warnings about potential market manipulation across other crypto projects. In response, crypto exchange OKX is funding ZachXBT's investigation into the incident.
title: RAVE Token Suffers 95% Collapse, OKX Funds Manipulation Probe

details: XRP is currently seeing renewed buying interest, supported by positive technical chart indicators and continued inflows from ETF money. This is contributing to its upward movement despite broader geopolitical uncertainties in the market.
title: XRP Gains Momentum with Favorable Charts and ETF Inflows

details: Dogecoin (DOGE) has seen a resurgence in interest, with its price increasing by 3.21% in the last 24 hours. This renewed attention is largely fueled by speculation that Elon Musk's upcoming 'X Money' ecosystem could integrate cryptocurrencies.
title: Dogecoin Rises on Elon Musk's 'X Money' Ecosystem Speculation

details: Fundstrat's Tom Lee has expressed optimism, stating that the "crypto winter is much closer to ending." This positive outlook coincides with significant institutional activity, such as Bitmine's substantial purchase of 101,627 ETH.
title: Tom Lee Predicts Crypto Winter Nearing End
